description: Get the evolving timeline, latest development, AI digest, and related events for one public story. Only pass a public_id obtained from aihot_get_hot_topics storyPublicId; never invent or infer IDs.

lang.description: Answer language: en gives the titles, summaries and digests in English where translated (the few not yet stay in Chinese), links to the English pages and English wording; zh (the default) answers in Chinese.

public_id.description: Opaque story public ID. Obtain it from aihot_get_hot_topics storyPublicId (or the final path segment of links.story); never guess it.

report_limit.description: Maximum number of timeline reports, from 1 to 50.

name: aihot_get_story
